meaning:
1) to lie stretched out, lie down
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to lie down
1a1a) for repose
1a1b) for copulation (of woman with beast)
1b) (Hiphil) to cause to lay down (of cattle breeding)
Also means: re.va (רֶבַע "to lie down" H7252)

elsewhere.note: “ ‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down with it: it is a perversion.
